description:
Moves foreground `jit serve` into `commands/serve.rs` as one operation that returns an outcome, so the CLI's serve path neither spawns processes itself nor calls `std::process::exit`.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/commands/serve.rs` owns the daemonizing start (`start_server` returning `ServeOutcome`), `stop_server` and `server_status`. Foreground mode (`jit serve --fg`) is assembled inline in the `Commands::Serve` arm of `crates/jit/src/main.rs`: it calls `read_pid_file` and `is_process_alive` to detect a running server, `find_available_port`, `find_server_binary` and `find_web_dir`, builds a `std::process::Command`, calls `spawn_with_listener`, blocks on `child.wait()`, prints a JSON or human result, and on a non-zero child calls `std::process::exit(foreground_exit_code(status.code()))`. The human banner (`Starting server on <url>`) is printed after the port is bound and before the wait.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `commands::serve::run_foreground` performs the already-running check, port selection, binary and web-dir resolution, spawn and wait, and returns a `ForegroundOutcome` that distinguishes an already-running server (pid, port) from an exited child (port, child exit status).
- [hard] REQ-02: The CLI serve path calls `run_foreground`, prints its banner through a callback or value the operation hands back before blocking, maps an exited child's status to the process exit code through `foreground_exit_code`, and its human output, JSON payloads and exit codes are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A unit test drives `run_foreground` with a stub server binary and shows the outcome carries the child's exit status (`test_run_foreground_reports_child_exit_status`); the existing serve suites pass unweakened.

## Notes

- REQ-02 amended 2026-10-24 by user decision: the serve arm keeps its one `std::process::exit`, because `main` has no exit path for a raw child status; 8c46fc85 REQ-03/REQ-04 remove it under plan D-23.
- Holding the retained mutation session across the wait deadlocks the child; the CLI keeps releasing it before calling the operation.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1, D-11); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Foreground serve as a commands-layer operation
